description:
Returns 1 to 13 series (ids from list_series), each on its own dates, from Aletheia's vintage store: every value with its date and kind (an absence is a kind with its reason, never a zero), the unit, source, limitation and the vintages the values came from. Default window: the last 365 days to `to`; pass `from` for the full history. With as_known_on, each series is returned as the store held it at the end of that day (UTC), so a figure quoted then can be reproduced.

With the data comes a chart plan, as the site's explorer draws: panels by unit, two at most, a series joining the panel of its exact unit; a third unit is refused in the explorer's words; ether and bitcoin collateral are never drawn on one panel; each refusal names its reason. The plan carries the /explore link that draws the same chart on the site, and a text alternative per panel. plan: 'only' returns the plan without the values; plan: false the values without the plan.

Values resting on CoinGecko prices carry coingecko_share or price_today, and the answer's attribution names every source to credit: show them with the values. This tool returns data; it does not advise, forecast or characterise the market.

Standard questions this tool answers (get_guide with question): SQ-M1, SQ-M2, SQ-M4, SQ-C1, SQ-C3, SQ-V4, SQ-S3.

as_known_on.description: YYYY-MM-DD: every series as the store held it at the end of that day (UTC)

plan.description: true (default): values and the chart plan; false: values only; 'only': the plan only

name: get_series
title: Series through time, with a chart plan
